settings.title: Read the Bible together in 365 days.
一年讀完聖經 · 全教會一同開始

settings.editor: Starting Sunday, October 4, all three congregations read the same passage each day. There is a printed plan in the foyer, a daily email, and a short discussion question for small groups — in Cantonese, Mandarin, and English.

STARTS: Sunday, October 4

PACE: About 15 minutes a day

LANGUAGES: 粵語 · 國語 · English
day one is Genesis 1 — catch up anytime
